notes.title: 20240420 Update
notes.content:
1. Open the Police Bureau, and you can pay a management fee of 500 rmb by talking to NPCs. Within the next month (30 days), the Urban Management Bureau will not manage stalls
2. When entering the game, achievements will be automatically detected based on the current save, to avoid situations where achievements are not activated properly due to lack of internet connection during gameplay
3. Reduce the size of the aiming icon in the game

notes.title: 2023.9.29 Update Announcement
notes.content:
1. Added merit related events, please experience them in the game for more details

2. New Test function has been added, which includes Year Month Day Divination, Sound Divination, and Character Divination. The Test function can be used for divination based on the player's own divination information, and can also be used for practice.

3.Fixed some translations
